tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol

zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / rgya gar skad du/ mahā sandhi tsitta tā swa mukti na ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo bo rnam dag bsam yul 'das pa las/ /rang bzhin lhun grub snying po'i gdangs shar ba/ /mtshan nyid sna tshogs gzung 'dzin dag pa'i sems/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun ma skyes mnyam pa'i ngang nyid las/ /snang sems ye grol 'dzin med phyam brdal ba/ / rmad byung rgyal po sems nyid rang grol ni/ /ji ltar bdag gis rtogs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /lta ba rnam dag mtha' dbus med pa la/ /'di zhes mi mtshon yangs dog mtho dman med/ /rtag chad las 'das mu bzhi'i dri ma bral/ /btsal na mi rnyed bltas pas mthong ba med/ /phyogs dang ris bral bsam yul kun las 'das/ /grub pa'i mtha' med stong dang mi stong med/ / rtogs dang ma rtogs rtsis gdab gza' gtad med/ /chos kun ye nas rnam dag byang chub pas/ /ma skyes mi 'gag smra bsam brjod du med/ /dag dang ma dag rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings/ /thams cad mi dmigs mnyam rdzogs chen po nyid/ /bcing grol med pas 'gro 'ong gnas pa med/ /snang stong kun brtags gzung 'dzin sgyu ma'i ngang*/ /'khor 'das bde sdug rmi lam bzang ngan 'dra/ /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /de las skye 'gag chen po rten 'brel nyid/ /rmi lam sgyu ma mig yor dri za'i grong*/ /brag ca gzugs brnyan 'dra ste ngo bo med/ /skye sogs chos kun rang bzhin ma skyes pas/ /nam yang mi 'gag dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /gang nas ma 'ong gang du ma song zhing*/ /gar yang mi gnas rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ /mi mkhas bden par zhen pa'i snang 'di la/ /ther zug chos su nga bdag 'dzin pa ni/ / sgyu ma'i na chung reg pas zhig pa 'dra/ /bslu bas mi bden snang ngor don byed bzhin/ /'gro drug gnas dang sangs rgyas zhing rnams kyang*/

/rdul phran 'dus min 'gro sems rang snang tsam/ /ji ltar rmi lam sangs rgyas sems can rnams/ /bden bden ltar snang rang bzhin dpag med kyang*/ /sad pa'i tshe na skad cig yid kyi yul/ /de bzhin 'khor 'das chos rnams shes par bya/ / snang ba'i ngos las log pa'i stong pa med/ /me dang me yi rang bzhin tsha ba bzhin/ /tha dad mos pa blo yis dbye ba ste/ /chu dang chu zla dbyer med rdzing bur gcig /de bzhin snang stong chos nyid chen por gcig /snang 'di gdod nas ma skyes chos kyi sku/ /dri med rang bzhin dag pa'i gzugs brnyan 'dra/ / de la yod med blos brtags 'khrul pas na/ /gang snang don la dmigs gtad ma byed cig /snang yul de yang sems kyi gzugs brnyan te/ /byad dang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gnyis su med bzhin gnyis su snang ba ni/ /thog med bags chags goms pa'i rang bzhin te/ /sems dang rmi lam gnyis su med mod kyang*/ /gnyid myos pa la rmi lam snang ba bzhin/ / ngo bo tha dad med par shes par bya/ /ji ltar bu chung me long mthong ba bzhin/ /byis pas phyi rol yul la dgag sgrub byed/ /a mas mthong bas me long phyis pa ltar/ /rgyu 'bras theg pas phyi rol bcos sgyur byed/ /bzang mos mthong ste bzhin la phyi ba ltar/ /de nyid shes pa nang gi sems nyid blta/ /'di ni dngos med snying po'i theg pa yin/ /sems gang ngo bo med la sna tshogs ni/ /yul gyi rkyen gyis nang du shar ba ste/ /me long rgya mtshor gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin/ /ngo bo stong la rang bzhin ma 'gags pa/ / mtshan nyid sna tshogs snang ba'i cho 'phrul ni/ /sems nyid gcig la 'khor 'das gnyis 'phro ba/ /dkar nag ras las shel la bsgyur ba bzhin/ /ngo bo mi 'gyur 'char gzhi rkyen snang gis/ /snang ba sna tshogs snang dus 'gyur 'dra yang*/ /don la ma 'gyur shel sgong dag pa bzhin/ /ye stong rtsa ba bral ba'i sems nyid la/

/'khor 'das chos rnams snang bas ma gos so/ /dus gsum dus med kun tu bzang po'i ngang*/ /gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngo bo la/ /yul drug snang bas ma gos chu zla 'dra/ /med snang sprul pa lta bu'i 'khor 'das la/ /blang dor dgag sgrub re dogs ma byed cig /sprul pa'i rang bzhin shes pas grol ba ni/ /sgyu ma'i dpung tshogs mthong bas bzung na yang*/ /rang bzhin shes pas 'jigs skrag med pa bzhin/ /snang ba'i yul rnams logs su spong mi dgos/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /ye nas ma skyes mya ngan 'das pas na/ /srid pa'i rang bzhin sems nyid mthong bas grol/ /de tshe zhi ba gzhan zhig bsgrub tu med/ /rang gi dpung la gzhan du skrag pa las/ /phyis nas shes pas slar yang bde ba thob/ /de ring dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /srid pa'i kun rtog chos skur ngo 'phrod pas/ /rang babs bde chen nang nas shar ba yin/ /spang blang mi dgos snang srid bla mar shar/ gdams ngag mi zad thams cad byang chub grogs/ /zhe bde'i steng du blo bde rgyun mi 'chad/ /thams cad yid bde chos nyid brdal ba las/ /sna tshogs chos can ma 'gag rol pa ni/ /chos sku gzugs sku snang stong tshogs gnyis ste/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam rjes lhun gyis grub/ /ma byas rang babs sku lnga ye shes lnga/ snang sems 'dzin med rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs/ /sa dang lam dang gzungs dang ting 'dzin te/ / yon tan lhun rdzogs chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /phyogs bral rig pa rang shar chen po la/ /bzung bas ma bslad 'dzin pas bcings pa med/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gnyis med dag pa la/ /bsam brjod ting 'dzin bsgom pas ci zhig bya/ /bskyed dang rdzogs med gnyis med zung 'jug med/ /grub pa'i mtha' med theg pa'i rnam dbye med/ /de dag kun brtags blo yi ri mo ste/ / rang shar ngang la rang grol btags pa tsam/ /'di yin gza' gtad med pa'i rig pa la/

/'di zhes ched du ma mdzin blo las 'das/ /byar med lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i sems nyid la/ /bcos bsgyur gnyen pos ma bslad gang bder thongs/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs mnyam pa'i chos nyid la/ /bsam gtan 'ching ba'i gzeb kyis ma bslad na/ /gnas lugs don la yod med snang stong med/ /gcig dang du bral la sogs mi mtshon zhing*/ /lta sgom las 'das grub bsal 'gro 'ong med/ /mtha' bral gnyis med sgyu ma rmi lam zhes/ /bden pa gnyis don bden zhen dgag phyir te/ /rnal ma'i don la don dam kun rdzob med/ /gang ltar brtags pa de ltar mi gnas shing*/ /'di zhes 'dzin pa de yi gzeb tu 'ching*/ /ji ltar 'dod kyang zhen pa'i mthar lhung zhing*/ /rtsol sgrub chos kyis 'khor ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /bzang ngan las kyis srid pa 'dir 'khyams te/ /bde sdug mtho dman zo chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin/ /dus gsum 'khor bar khams gsum 'gro ba 'khrul/ /ma rig kun brtags rtsol ba'i nad kyis gdung*/ /thog mtha' dus med sems can snying re rje/ /kye ho de kun rmi lam sgyu ma tsam/ /nges pa'i don la 'khor dang mkhor mkhan med/ /thams cad ye grol kun tu bzang po'i ngang*/ /gzhi rtsa dngos po med pas blo re bde/ /ma gcos gdod nas dag pa'i sems nyid la/ /snang srid chos kyis ma gos gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /snang ba'i yul la gzung ba mi dmigs shing*/ /rang shar blo la 'dzin pa mi dmigs pa'i/ /gnyis med ye shes gnyis su snang las byung*/ /de phyir yul sems mi 'gags rgyan du che/ / 'dzin med glang chen thab la yan pa ni/ /rang grol 'gros can gnyis med dra bas mdzes/ /blang dor re dogs 'dam bu'i tshal 'joms shing*/ /rtogs pa'i stobs 'chang gnyis med rgya mtshor 'jug /shar grol rim pa sna med yan pa la/ /spang gnyen zhen pa'i thag pas ma 'ching bar/ /rlabs chen rdzogs pa'i lta ba kha yan skyong*/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i snang srid chos skur 'char/

/yul drug ma 'gags snang mkhan ngo bos stong*/ /mtha' bral sems nyid gtad med grol ba na/ /'khor 'das gnyis med rig pa gzhi thog phyin/ /mchog gi dngos grub brnyes zhes de la bya/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs pa'i mthar phyin pas/ /'og min gnas su mngon par byang chub yin/ /e ma phyugs dang 'dra ba'i bsam gtan pa/ /'du shes bkag nas rtog med gnas pa la/ /gnas lugs nyid ces mngon pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin/ / de nyid goms pas dud 'gro'i sar 'phen cing*/ /ma goms na yang bsam gtan gzugs med nyid/ /'khor ba'i gnas las grol ba'i skabs med do/ /de bas ches cher mngon pa'i nga rgyal can/ /rang rang grub mtha'i gdon gyis zin pa dag /blos brtags 'khrul pa'i chos kyi rjes 'brang byed/ /kun brtags dri mas chos nyid don mi mthong*/ /bden gnyis gzhal kyang rtag chad mthar lhung zhing*/ /mtha' bral gzhal yang srid rtse'i lta ba ston/ /ji ltar byas kyang grub pa'i mthas bcings nas/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes nam yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /rnal ma'i don ni bsam brjod dmigs pas sgrib/ / bsam brjod dmigs ni rnal mar ma shes pas/ /btsal ba'i don ni rtsol mkhan byas pas gol/ /sems dang ye shes chu dang rlan byad bzhin/ /dus rnams kun tu 'du 'bral med pa la/ /spang blang yid kyis so sor phye bas bslad/ /gang snang yul sems gnyug ma'i ngo bo la/ /phyogs ris 'dzin pas nam mkha' gud du bcad/ /da ni dmigs med chos sku'i don 'dod na/ / gnyug ma'i yul la tshol khro ma byed par/ /gang shar rgyal po dmigs gtad zhen pa bshol/ /phyogs ris ma bcad 'di yin ngos bzung med/ /gang ltar shar ba de ltar ma grub cing*/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar rang bzhin med/ /tha mal snang sems ye grol zang ka ma/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba yin/ /chos rnams rang bzhin nam mkhas mtshon byas kyang*/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos rnams dmigs su med/

/sems nyid ma skyes chos rnams mkha' 'dra zhes/ /ming tsam brjod kyang brda tsam btags pa tsam/ /yin min phyogs bral bsam las 'das pa la/ /'di zhes mi mtshon ye rdzogs phyam gcig go /kye ho snang srid rang bzhin rnam dag la/ /'dzin med rig pa glo bur rnam dag shar/ /shar tsam nyid nas gang du mi gnas pa/ /rang grol rdzogs chen nam zhig mthong bar 'gyur/ /rtsa bral gdod nas dag pa'i sems nyid la/ /bya rgyu byed mkhan med pas blo re bde/ /thams cad gza' gtad med pa'i rig pa la/ /'di yin ched 'dzin zhig pas dang re spro/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa'i lta sgom la/ /yangs dogs mtho dman med pas nyams re dga'/ /blang dor re dogs med pa'i spyod 'bras la/ /thob dang ma thob med pas bag re dro/ /thams cad mnyam rdzogs sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la/ / bzang ngan blang dor med pas dgod re bro/ /snang sems 'al 'ol sang sing khral ma khrol/ /ban bun chad chod zang thal gnyug ma la/ /gang snang der yin der snang 'dzin pa med/ /yin min blo yin blo bral chos sku yin/ /gtad med yul la nges med snang ba shar/ /'dzin med shes pa gnyis med grol ba'i tshe/ /snang sems chos rnams sems kyi rol mor che/ /gzhi rtsa dngos po med pa'i sems nyid la/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan rdzogs/ / dgag sgrub chos skur grol bas blo bde rnyed/ /ched du dmigs pa thams cad bcos ma ste/ /dmigs med gang shar shar na ye shes dngos/ /spang blang rang sar grol bas blo bde rnyed/ /spang blang rang sar grol bas bsam yul 'das/ /ma lus rang bzhin dag pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rang sems nyid las gzhan du btsal mi bya/ /tshol mkhan gol bas btsal bya log na med/ /sgyu ma'i rigs dang smig rgyu'i chu snyegs 'dra/ /'khor 'das gnyis med gnyis su 'dzin pa ni/ /rang byung rig pa bcos bslad med par zad/ /gang gis chos kun mnyam pa'i don mthong nas/

/sems nyid ma skyes mkha' ltar rtogs pa ni/ /snang srid snod bcud rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing*/ /ma skyes lhun rdzogs mnyam pa'i ngang du phyin/ /snang sems ngo bo stong pas chos sku'i don/ / rang bzhin ma 'gags longs sku'i snang ba la/ /mtshan nyid sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur shes pas/ /thams cad sku gsum ye shes dag pa'i zhing*/ /bcos bsgyur spang gnyen med pa'i blo bde 'o/ /e ma 'gro bas gnyis su bzung ba yis/ /rmi lam 'khrul pa'i 'khor bar gnas dus 'dir/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras te/ /mi rtog kun gzhi goms pas gzugs med la/ /gsal stong kun gzhi'i rnam shes gzugs kyi khams/ /tshogs drug nyid la goms pas 'dod par 'khrul/ /sems kyis bcos bsgyur srid pa'i them skas la/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis ma bcos rnal ma'i don/ /sems la las med dal du 'jug pa 'o/ /tha mal shes pa bzo med lhug pa la/ /'khor 'das 'dzin pas ma gos rang sar grol/ /de ltar grol bas rang bab skad cig la/ /gnas la mi rtogs chos sku'i ngang nyid la/ /'char gzhi ma 'gag gsal stong longs spyod rdzogs/ /'phro na shar grol sprul skur thag chod pas/ /'khor ba'i kun rtog mya ngan 'das par nges/ /kye ho snang sems rang bzhin 'gyur bas kyang*/ /chos sku gza' gtad bral ba'i me long ltos/ / gtad med chos la 'dzin med shar ba ni/ /sems kyi gsang yin gzhan zhig mtshon du med/ /lhun grub rig pa gang shar snying po'i don/ /rang bzhin babs yin bcos bslad ma byed cig /chos rnams dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /'dzin med sems kyi nam mkha' mtha' dbus med/ /ma byas 'gag pa med pa'i rang shar yang*/ /dgag sgrub mtshan 'dzin med pa rnal ma'i don/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par shes par bya/ /yul sems gnyis med gnyug ma'i ye shes ni/ /rtogs pas mtshon te bstan cing bstan du med/ /don dam sems nyid rang bzhin gnas na mdzes/

/bsam gtan mi g.yo rtog dpyod shes rab dang*/ /lung rig man ngag mang pos go yul tsam/ /rjen pa'i ye shes nam yang thob mi nus/ nam mkha' 'di zhes mdzub mos mtshon byas kyang*/ /mthong ba'i yul min rnam phye'i go ba tsam/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par 'char ba ni/ /nyi ma'i snying pos mun pa bsal ba bzhin/ /skad cig rig pas chos skur mthong ma thag /ma rig ye shes nyon mongs mtshon par song*/ /dngos po kun gyis g.yo med bsnyen par bkur/ /mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub tshe 'dir thob/ /rmongs rnams srid sngangs mya ngan 'das pa 'tshol/ /nam yang mi rnyed nor bu dor byas nas/ /byi dor bya ba'i nor bu gzhan blangs te/ /dri ma sbyangs shing 'ching bu 'tshol ba bzhin/ /sems nyid rang grol nor bu rin po che/ /rang ngo shes pas 'khrul pa'i dri ma dag /de nyid shes pas yon tan rin chen gter/ / rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa'i snying po yin/ /sems nyid don gyi rtogs pa shar ba na/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin 'phro gnas chos sku'i ngang*/ /gang ltar byung yang dgag sgrub mi dgos pas/ /dus rnams kun tu dgag sgrub bya mi dgos/ /dus rnams kun tu blo bde'i rnal 'byor la/ /chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor chen po yin/ /thams cad mnyam rdzogs rang bzhin chen po'i ngang*/ /rig tsam shar bas ngang dwangs 'od gsal zhing*/ /yang gcig 'phros kyang de bzhin chos nyid ngang*/ /'od gsal rig pa mtha' dbus med pa'i tshe/ /nyon mongs gnyen po gnyis su med pas na/ /spang gnyen bral thob re dogs rang sar grol/ /nor bu sgron me'i brtags pa ma shes pas/ /sgrom me'i 'od la nor bur zhen pa yin/ /rang grol nyams dang bsam gtan ma phyed na/ /shar grol rang la zhen pas 'ching ba byed/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i dbye ba ma shes na/ /goms pa'i nyams la rtogs par 'dzin pas 'khrul/ / rtogs nas dus kun bzang ngan 'pho 'gyur med/ /de nyid goms pas yon tan nyams rnams 'byung*/

/ji ltar mkha' la 'byung bzhi'i 'pho 'gyur gyis/ / nam yang mi g.yo nam mkha' sngon bzhin gnas/ /de bzhin sems nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /'phel 'grib nyams kyi rtogs pa bzang ngan med/ /bzang ngan byung na nyams yin rtogs pa min/ /thag chod rtogs pa dam pa'i drung du btsal/ /phyi nas mi g.yo de bzhin mnyam par gnas/ /'di bsgom nges pa don gyi lta ba ste/ /yang rab dbang po de nyid mthong bas grol/ /goms la mi ltos thams cad rtogs pa 'char/ /spang bya med pas goms byed gnyen po med/ /nad med pa la sman dag mi dgos bzhin/ / phyogs bral lta ba 'dzin med shes par gyis/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol las/ /gzhi rtogs pas grol pa'i le'u ste ngang po'o// //sgom pa rang bab rang grol chen po la/ /bcos bsgyur mi dgos gang shar rdzogs pa che/ /blang dor mi dgos gdod ma'i ngang nyid du/ /phyi nang 'khor 'das chos rnams phyam brdal lo/ /gang byung rig pa tshogs drug lhug pa la/ /ma bcos rig pa bu chung lta bur zhog

/gzhi bral ngang du blo bral las 'das na/ /bsam med rgyal po 'gyur med lhun gyis grub/ /tha mal shes pa bzo med lhug pa la/ /rang bab shes pa chu la chu bzhag bzhin/ /gnyis med shes pa bcos bslad bral bar bzhag /byar med shes pa chos nyid chen por gnas/ /sems dal khong yangs ngang gis blo bde la/ /rang bab lhun chags rgan bu lta bur zhog /thun mtshams rtsi med rang shar chen po'i ngang*/ /rang grol rig pa rgya yan chen por gnas/ /gtad med rig pa zang thal chen po la/ /'dzin med rig pa smyon pa lta bur zhog /brtul zhugs rig pa phyogs ris med pa'i ngang*/ /rkyen ngan sna tshogs chos nyid rol par 'char/ /sna tshogs rang sems rig pa'i cho 'phrul la/ /nyams nga med pa seng ge lta bur zhog /'khrul snang zil gnon ye shes chen po'i ngang*/ /shugs 'byung rig pa rang grol chen por 'char/ /rtogs pa'i ngo bo klong du ma gyur bar/ /nyin mtshan gnyis med lce spyang mig ltar zhog /goms shing 'dris pas ma bu 'phrod gyur na/ /thams cad phyam gcig rgya yan chen por 'char/ /phyogs bral rig pa mtha' dbus med pa la/ /'di zhes mi mtshon nam mkha' lta bur zhog /sgom med rig pa bcos bslad med pa'i don/ /rang byung rig pa rang bzhin khong nas 'char/ /nyon mongs rnyog bral rang dwangs chen po la/ /ngang dwangs rig pa rgya mtsho lta bur zhog /shar grol rig pa rba rlabs chen po bzhin/ /byad dang me long gza' skar gzugs brnyan 'char/ /sems nyid mi g.yo 'pho 'gyur med pa la/ /chos nyid mi g.yo ri rgyal lta bur zhog/ mnyam rdzogs rig pa lhun rdzogs 'dus ma byas/ /bya rtsol gnyis med btang snyoms lhun gyis grub/ /gnyug ma'i sems nyid rang shar rang grol la/ /rgyun chad med pa chu bo lta bur zhog /ci skyes rnam rtog chos sku ro gcig pas/ / spang blang mi dgos phyam gcig mya ngan 'das/ /mdor na gang shar chos nyid rol pa la/ /dmigs med rang grol mnyam gzhag lhun gyis grub/

/res 'jog mi dmigs sgom yun chen po'i ngang*/ /le lo med par rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyang bya/ /de yi bogs 'byin lam gyi cha rkyen du/ /sgyu ma'i spyod pas blang dor gnyis med pas/ /rkyen ngan lam lhongs mnyam rjes bsre ba'i phyir/ /ri rtse dur khrod mtsho gling tshong dus sogs/ /yul gyis sems la g.yengs ba'i gnas song nas/ /lus ni bro gar ngag ni glu len cing*/ /sems ni kun rtog sna tshogs spros byas la/ /skad cig rang grol lta sgom ngang du bsre/ /phyi nas thams cad lam du lhongs pa yin/ /bar 'ga' snang srid bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang mi rtag 'chi ba bsgom/ /snang srid chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma'i ngang*/ /sgra brnyan smig rgyu gzugs brnyan sprul pa 'dra/ / mig yor chu zla'i rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang*/ /sna tshogs snang ba bden med 'al 'ol du/ /skad cig skad cig ngos bzung med par sbyangs/ /nyin mtshan ma yengs mnyam rjes rtsal sbyangs pas/ /shar grol rang gnas bde gsal mi rtog dang*/ /rang gnas sgom pa rgyun mi 'chad pa la/ /'khrul pa'i rmi lam bden med 'od gsal du/ /nyin mtshan 'dres pas 'khor 'das rang sar grol/ /lta bas yun thob sgom pas yengs thub cing*/ /spyod pas rkyen thub 'bras bus gol sa thub/ /rtogs pa'i rang bzhin mi rtog ye shes su/ /dus rnams kun tu 'pho 'gyur med pa gnas/ /de tshe rang bzhin gcig ste gdod ma'i sar/ /sgom med don la gtan srid zin pa yin/ /phyi nas 'bras bu bde chen btsal du med/ /gang shar rig pa sku gsum lhun grub la/ /rang gzhan don rnams 'bad rtsol med par 'grub/ /rig pa yon tan phyogs bral nyag gcig 'char/ /de ltar tshe 'dir grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sa chu me rlung rnam shes 'od gsal thim/ /ye shes ngang la dbyings dang rab 'dres nas/ /gdod ma'i sa la gtan srid zin pa yin/ /gzhan don sku gnyis ye shes rmi lam bzhin/

/'gro la snang ba dgos pa'i yon tan yin/ /'di ni rig pa'i rang bzhin sems kyi gsang*/ /skad cig rang sar grol ba'i mchog rig nas/ /ches cher gong du 'phel ba'i yon tan ni/ /tshes gcig nas bzung bco lnga'i bar 'phel bas/ /zla ba rgyas 'dra 'jig rten snang mod kyang*/ /don la 'phel 'grib gang yang med par ltar/ /rtogs pa'i ngo mthong goms pa'i rtsal rgyas kyang*/ /rtogs pa mi g.yo goms pa'i yon tan 'byung*/ /zla ba gsal bas grib ma chung pa'am/ /kha cig grib ma chung bas zla rgyas ltar/ /gnyis 'dzin bral bas nyams rtogs 'phel ba'am/ /rtogs pa 'phel bas nyon mongs chung gyur ste/ /spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin yang*/ /ngo bo mi 'gyur rang bzhin mi 'gag cing*/ /chos nyid sna tshogs rkyen grol rnam par dag /mdor na nyon mongs rtogs par ma shar na/ /dug lnga spangs nas lam mchog gzhan na med/ /sku gcig rang grol gsang 'di ma shes na/ /nyon mongs gnyen po gnyis su 'dzin pas bslu/ /'gags la gzung 'dzin rang sar ma grol na/ /kha lta mtho yang bdud kyi gsang tshig tsam/ /bsam gtan bzang yang gong ma'i bde 'bras tsam/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras tsam/ /lta ba yang la sgom pa kha zlum zhing*/ /spyod pa dul zhing ched 'dzin grol ba gces/ /gang la shar grol gnyis med yangs pa'i ngang*/ gtad med chos la yengs med shar ba'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal ba'i rtags/ /gzung bas ma bcings 'dzin pa'i zhen pa med/ /thams cad mnyam rdzogs chos skur bde klong 'khyil/ /la brgal lung brgal 'phrang brgal 'jigs pa med/ /rang yul phyin pas re dogs kun las 'das/ /de ltar goms pas 'byung ba rnam pa bzhi/ /'dzin med lam gyi drod tshad 'di bzhin 'byung*/ /sngon bsags las dang bla ma'i thugs rje dang*/ /dus thabs mkhas pas rten 'brel tshogs pa'i tshe/ /rang byung rig pa zang thal kha gang ma/ /shar grol 'dzin med lhag gis rtogs pa'i tshe/

/chos nyid mngon sum snang ba chen po yin/ /phyi nang snang brtags chos skur thag chod pas/ /ji ltar shar yang blang dor bcos bsgyur med/ /thams cad rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyong gcig tu 'char/ /de nyid goms pas gong du 'phel ba'i tshe/ /phyi nang dgag sgrub rkyen ngan lam du bslang*/ /shar bas grol la gnas pas bde ba rnyed/ /goms pas spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /rig pa'i yon tan sna tshogs shar ba na/ /nyams snang gong 'phel snang bar shes par bya/ /de las ches cher goms pa klong gyur pas/ /rig pa gsal stong rjen pa'i ye shes la/ /bying rgod gnyis med yengs dang ma yengs med/ /mnyam rjes gnyis med rtag tu chu bo 'dra/ /yon tan drod tshad khyad 'phags thob pa'i tshe/ /rig pa tshad phebs snang ba mthong ba yin/ /de nyid ngang las rtag tu mi g.yo zhing*/ /mtshan 'dzin mi dmigs spang gnyen zhen yul 'das/ /thams cad mnyam rdzogs ched 'dzin gza' gtad bral/ /phyi nang chos la 'dzin pa zad pa na/ /chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mthong ba yin/ /de nas rig pa bzhi la mthar phyin pas/ /chos sku'i ngang du gzugs sku mya ngan 'das/ /snang 'dzin stong pa las 'das grol pa'i tshe/ /gdod ma'i sa la gtan srid zin pa yin/ /de ltar goms tshe lam nyid ma 'chugs pas/ /rmi lam tshad kyang rnam pa gsum du bstan/ /dang por snang sems shar grol rtsal sbyangs pas/ /ngan pa'i rmi lam bzang po bsgyur ba na/ /las ngan byang bas dge ba ro gcig rtags/ /me las du ba sa bon myu gu bzhin/ /bar du goms pas rmi lam zin pa dang*/ /skad cig grol bas dus mnyam 'byung ba ni/ /gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol ba'i rtags/ /klong du gyur pas shin tu goms pa ni/ /rmi lam rgyun chad nyin mtshan 'od gsal gnas/ /'khor ba'i kun rtog dpyis su nub pa'i rtags/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das nas phyam gcig pas/ /gdod ma'i zad sar gtan srid zin du nye/ /khams gsum sgo gsum sku gsum sar grol nas/

/zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /ye nas grub bsal med pa'i sems nyid la/ /bcos bsgyur gnyen po mi dgos gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /phyogs ris 'dzin pa kun las grol bas na/ /sgom dang bsgom bya med par lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar shes pa tha mal rang grol la/ /phyi nang mi dmigs gzung 'dzin mtha' las 'das/ /dgag sgrub rang grol spang gnyen gnyug mar shar/ /gang yin 'di yin gza' gtad med par grol/ /blang dor mi dgos kun khyab ye shes ni/ /phyogs bral bde chen ma btsal lhun gyis grub/ /ye grol sor bzhag yongs grol chen po ni/ / gang yin 'di yin kun yin ngos bzung med/ /gtad med 'dzin med yod med mtha' las 'das/ /kye ho phyogs gcig ye nas yongs grol bas/ / 'bad med rig pa mnyam pa'i ngang du grol/ /lhun rdzogs rgyal po ma skyes mi 'gag pas/ /mi gnas mi dmigs rang bzhin brjod du med/ /thams cad byar med gnyug ma'i ngang nyid do/ /a ho/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i snang ba la/ /ya mtshan gad mo 'chor ba'i rig pa shar/ /yul sems gnyis med snang mkhan ngo bos stong*/ /'di zhes mi mtshon gtad med chen por grol/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam rdzogs gcig gi ngang*/ /thams cad mi g.yo de bzhin mnyam par gnas/ /gza' dang rgyu skar tshes grangs mi dmigs shing*/ /dus dang sbyor ba byed pa'i yul las 'das/ /gling bzhi mi gnas ri rab nyi zla stong*/ /dkyil 'khor mi dmigs bzlas brjod dka' thub med/ /yul rnams mi dmigs rtsa khams 'khor lor stong*/ /phyi rol nyid kyang snang bzhin mi dmigs pas/ /'jig rten khams kun yul lnga ngo bos stong*/ /thams cad ma byung rang byung gzhal yas khang*/ /byed po mi dmigs snying po don gyi lha/ /rnam rtog 'phro 'du ye shes rol mor che/ /yul rnams mchod sprin ye shes lha mchod pas/ tshogs chen lhun rdzogs sgra tshig gsang sngags che/ /nyon mongs ye shes rang byung rdzogs rim nyid/

/bya rtsol mi dgos rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /sa dang lam rdzogs pha rol phyin pa'i ngang*/ /dbu mar mi gnas zung 'jug rnam par dag /spang gnyen gol sgrib rdul tsam mi dmig pas/ /gang shar sgom pa ma byas lhun gyis grub/ /rnam par dbye dang rnam dbye med pa'i chos/ /dkar nag dge sdig las 'bras rten 'brel tsam/ /rang ngos stong la gzugs brnyan mi 'dor bas/ /kun nas 'das pa'i rang grol shes par bya/ /bzang ngan las kyis 'khor ba mtho dman grub/ /las las 'das na rang bzhin mya ngan 'da'/ /blang dor byed na mi dge nges par grol/ /dge ba sgrub kyang zhen pas 'ching mi bya/ /phyi nas blang dor med pa'i don btsal las/ /dam pa rnams la tshad btsugs sgrub la 'bad/ /don med bslu ba byis pa'i chos spangs te/ /rtag tu skye bo dam pa bsten pa dang*/ /rtogs pa'i sngon 'gro ma nor thos bsam bya/ /gcig pur sran tshugs dben pa'i ri ngogs su/ /sems thag bcad la don dam snying po blang*/ /mi rtag skyo shas blo sna bstung byas la/ /snying nas chos la 'bad pas sgrub pa gces/ /da res tshe la thar lam ma bgrod na/ /phyis nas dal 'byor chos dang 'phrad par dka'/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan dben pa'i sar btsugs nas/ /da lta shi na khyer so ci 'dug blta/ /de ltar nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' byas na/ /sgyu lus 'dor yang sems nyid skye 'chi med/ /'gyur med chos sku'i rgyal srid zin pa yin/ /tshe 'di don yod mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /dbang po 'bring dang tha ma'i gang zag kyang*/ /bar dor grol zhing phyi ma 'bras dang bcas/ /'khor ba'i las las thar pa'i lam rnyed nas/ /bde chen sa la sems nyid btsan sa zin/ /'di ni nges pa don gyi snying po yin/ / nor sa'i lam la phyin zhing gol sgrib mang*/ /snying po'i de nyid nam yang mi rnyed cing*/ /tshe 'dir ngal la phyi ma 'bras bu med/ /des na lta sgom ma nor btsal bar bya/

/byams dang snying rje byang chub sems med na/ /theg chen lam las gzhan zhig yin par nges/ /ji tsam bsgom zhing rang rgyud gyong ba na/ / chos dang gang zag so sor song bar nges/ /phyi dang dngos dang bar bsgom zhen pa na/ /gnyis med rtogs pa'i skal ba med par nges/ /nges 'byung skyo shas 'chi ba ma dran na/ /tshe 'dir zhen pa'i bdud kyis bslus par nges/ / bsgoms kyang yon tan gsar du ma skyes na/ /gol sgrib gtings sogs bying rgod byung bar nges/ /zhi gnas rlan gyis lhag mthong ma zin na/ /lhag mthong ma yin rtogs pa'i ri mo yin/ /go yul kha ltas gnyis med don smras kyang*/ / rkyen ngan mi thub dug lnga rags pa'i grogs/ /lhag mthong rtsal gyis zhi gnas ma zin na/ /zhi gnas ma yin gti mug sems gnas tsam/ /bsam gtan chags pa legs kyang gong ma'i rgyu/ /bying rgod ltongs pas dud 'gro'i sgom pa la/ /rtag tu ma chags lhag mthong ye shes rtsal/ /dam pas bstan pas dri med rtogs pa'i tshe/ /sgom gyi tshul 'chang thams cad byang chub grogs/ /ma byas bde gsal mi rtog khong nas 'char/ /de nyid ma yin nges pa'i snying po min/ /da lta rig pa'i gsang 'di ma rtogs na/ /sgom la phar 'chang blang dor sgrog tu 'ching*/ /'dod pa nyung la mi 'dod char bzhin 'bab/ /re ba mi 'grub dogs pas rgyun du gnod/ /lus ngag yid bcos bde gsal mi rtog kyang*/ /byis pa'i bum 'dzin 'jig pas phan mi thogs/ / ma byas mi 'jig yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rang bab gnyug ma'i rtogs pa btsal ba gces/ /lus bcos ngag bsdams sems bsgrims rnam rtog bkag /har re sang nge rig pa'i mdung tshugs kyang*/ /'dzin pa'i ngang du 'du shes tshor bkag nas/ /bsam gtan gzugs med 'khor ba sgrub par snang*/ /dbang po'i snang yul rtog med gsal snang dang*/ /dug lnga rang grol ye shes chen po'i ngang*/ /bying rgod gseng ba phra mo'i rig pa la/

/spang byar zhen pas phra rags sbom gsum zhes/ /mgrin bzang rnams kyis spang ba'i thabs la brtson/ /snga ma'i shes pa phyi mas dran byas te/ /tshor tsam nyid kyis gnyug ma'i don mthong zhes/ /skye 'gag grangs 'debs rtog pa'i 'phro mthud la/ /gnyis med don du 'dzin pa'i sgom pa 'khrul/ /ci tsam 'bad kyang rtog pa'i drwa ba las/ /phyi ma skyes tshe snga ma 'gag pa'i chos/ /grol bar zhen pa snga phyir rang grol min/ /thabs lam dbang po bde ba lhur len pa/ /chags sred 'dzin pas phal cher ngan song rgyu/ /bde 'gro thob kyang dman pa'i gnas su skye/ /rnal 'byor brgya lam 'ga' yi lam yin zhes/ /gol sgrib shas che rtogs pa'i don mthong dkon/ /tshogs gnyis bskyed rdzogs yod med res 'jog can/ /nges pa'i don zhes 'bad kyang bde 'bras chung*/ /mtho ris nyid de 'khor ba chad mi nus/ /mdor na skye ba sngon bsags skal pa zhan/ / log gol dman pa'i lam zhugs snying re rje/ /nam zhig kun kyang legs pa'i ma nor lam/ /ji bzhin rnyed nas de bzhin grol bar shog /gang la ma nor stong nyid snying rje che/ /skad cig grol ba rang gnas chos sku'i lam/ / 'char ba shes rab lhag mthong rjen pa nyid/ /gnas pas thabs yin zhi gnas mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /rang bab zung 'jug bcos bslad kun dang bral/ /'gyur ba'i yengs la gnas pas rnam par gnon/ /bying rgod gnyis med nyon mongs rtsa bral ngang*/ /ji ltar shar yang rang grol chos sku la/ /gang ltar gnas kyang gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /blang dor mi dgos sems nyid rnal ma'i don/ /gnyug ma'i ngo bo chos nyid ye shes la/ /goms pa'i rtsal sbyong rgyun chad med par mdzod/ /'di ni gnas lug gnyug ma'i rang grol te/ /mchog gi sgom pa yang zab bla na med/ /snying po'i bcud dril yang nas yang bsdus pa/ /rdo rje rtse mo kun gyi snying po yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol las/

/dbang po 'bring thabs lam goms thog nas grol ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //'bras bu lhun grub gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis/ /gnas skabs lta ba sgom pas yon tan thob/ /nyon mongs gzung 'dzin rang sar grol ba dang*/ /phyi nang chos la bstan pa thob pa dang*/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul grub pa dang*/ /rtogs pa gong 'phel gzhan don snying rje 'byung*/ /de tshe skad cig rig pa'i ye shes la/ /cha yis dbye na yon tan 'di dag go /snang ba thabs yin bskyed rim bsod nams tshogs/ /nyon mongs kun rtog gzung ba'i rtog pa spang*/ /stong pa shes rab rdzogs rim ye shes tshogs/ /shes sgrib lhan skyes 'dzin rtog rang sar grol/ /ser sna tshul 'chal khong khro le lo g.yengs/ /shes 'chal mi mkhas nyam chung mi smon dang*/ /rmongs pa'i phyogs bcu rnam par dag pa'i chos/ /sbyin tshul bzod brtson bsam gtan shes rab thabs/ /stobs smon ye shes pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par shar ba'i tshe/ /dga' bde mchog skyes sa rab dga' ba ste/ / nyon mongs rang grol dri ma med pa'i sa/ /bde gsal mi rtog ye shes 'od byed pa/ /'phro ba'i kun rtog rang grol 'od 'phro can/ /mchog las kun gyi yul min spyad dka' ba/ /rtogs pa mngon gyur mngon du gyur pa'i sa/ / 'khor ba las grol ring du song ba ste/ /rtogs pa mi g.yo ri rgyal mi g.yo ba/ /kun gyi mchog yin legs pa'i blo gros can/ /yid mkha' khyab pas bcu pa chos kyi sprin/ /bsod nam ye shes rnam dag tshogs sbyor la/ /rtogs pa'i don mthong goms pas mthong goms nyid/ /grol ba'i 'bras bu'i sa zhes brjod pa yin/ /dug gsum grol ba sde snod gsum tshang zhing*/ /sgo gsum dag pa bslab gsum rnam par dag

/thams cad grol bya de nyid spyod pa dang*/ /rtogs pa'i klong gyur rnal 'byor bla na med/ /rgyud sde bzhi tshang rang don nyan rang la/ /gzhan don theg chen rtogs pa kri ya ste/ /goms pas u pa spyod pas yo ga'o/ /thabs dang shes rab ma hā a nu la/ /rang rdzogs a ti rim dgu kun dang mthun/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin ye shes snying po can/ /rang grol skad cig dbye ba gnas pa ni/ /sa dang lam dang sangs rgyas go gcig don/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes sems sangs phyag rgya che/ /mnyam rdzogs lhun grub chen po phyam gcig go /mthar thug 'bras bu mi gnas gdod ma'i ngang*/ /chos sku'i zhing khams bsam 'das brjod du med/ / dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig gyur pa na/ /mngon par byang chub sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /phra ba'i ye shes mkha' dbyings 'khyil pa la/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin 'char bzhin gnas/ /grub bsal med pa'i chos nyid lhun rdzogs dang*/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /de las rnam dag stug po bkod pa'i zhing*/ /rang snang 'od gsal dkyil 'khor lhun rdzogs nas/ /rigs lnga lton pa mtshan rdzogs 'od zer 'phro/ /chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes lda lnga'i rang bzhin las/ / phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rang snang gdul bya'i 'khor/ dkyil 'khor rigs lnga til gyi gong bu rnyed/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams nam mkha' khyab par gnas/ /sgo dang sgo khyud rta bab mu khyud sogs/ /so so'i rigs dang mthun par rnam par bkra/ /thams cad lhun rdzogs dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang*/ / mnyam rdzogs chos kyis mtha' dbus med par khyab/ /dus gsum dus med kun tu bzang po'i dus/ gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang nyid do/ /de las rang bzhin sprul sku rigs lnga'i zhing*/ /'og min mngon dga' rin chen yongs gang dang*/ /padma brtsegs dang las rab grub pa ru/ /ston pa rigs lnga sa bcu'i 'khor rnams la/

/dus gsum kun tu gzugs bzang me long ston/ /'od zer 'khyil pas sa bcu'i sgrib sbyangs te/ /kun tu 'od la 'khod pa'i phrin las mdzad/ /zhing der rgyal sras dag pa'i tshogs la snang*/ /longs sku'i zhal las 'phros pa'i 'od zer las/ /lha dang lha min mi dang dud 'gro dang*/ /yi dwags dmyal ba 'jig rten drug po ru/ /brgya byin thags bzang shākya thub pa dang*/ /seng ge rab brtan kha 'bar de ba dang*/ /a wa glang mgo mthun pa'i snang gzugs kyis/ /ma dag don mdzad zhi ba'i dbyings su brten/ /sna tshogs sprul pa bzo dang skye ba dang*/ /rdzing dang zam pa padma dpag bsam shing*/ /sman dang nor bu sgron me la sogs pa/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid dga' ba'i gnas mdzad nas/ /mthar thug nges par legs pa'i phrin las mdzad/ /gdul bya zad nad 'dul byed dbyings su nub/ /de yang rnam pa gsum du shes par bya/ /sna tshogs sprul dang 'gro 'dul nub pa ni/ /chu snod med pas chu zla nub pa bzhin/ /rang bzhin rol pa'i 'phro 'du rol pa tsam/ /nam zhig gdul bya'i sar gnas zhi ba na/ /'dul byed rang bzhin sprul pa'i rigs lnga yang*/ /rang snang longs skur gnyis med rang thim nas/ / gnam gang zla ba dbyings su nub pa bzhin/ /chos sku'i dbyings su rang snang longs sku nub/ /phyi ru mi snang rang ngor dkyil 'khor che/ /snga phyi 'phel 'grib 'pho 'gyur med par gnas/ /'phel 'grib snang bas zla ba mi 'phrog bzhin/ /yang gcig gdul bya yod na sngon bzhin snang*/ /'di dag mthar phyin grol ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol las/ /'bras bu lhun grub chen po'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /de ltar legs bshad nyi ma'i snying po 'di/ /dri med 'od zer shar bas snang bar byas/ /deng sang rtsod dus lta ngan mun pas bsgribs/ /de nyid bsal phyir nges pa'i lam 'di bkod/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag 'dra 'gro ba kun/

/ma lus phyam gcig gdod ma'i sar grol nas/ /spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin te/ /gzhan don lhun grub chos kyi rgyal po shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma sambha bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul o rgyan rdzong gi gnas mchog dam par phyi rabs kyi don du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (22) rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol/ - PAGE 376 -- PAGE 375 - - PAGE 365 -
